issues.on_page: General: Intergovernmental 132,763 (= Sales and use tax 82,060 + State aid and equalization 50,703 on p2)
issues.issue: Sales tax is 62% of this fund column, so by the more-than-half rule it should be sales tax, or split. Tying the fund column to the p2 lines relies on an exact amount match.

issues.on_page: Street: Intergovernmental 85,866 (= Motor vehicle tax 85,866 on p2)
issues.issue: This column equals the printed Motor vehicle tax line exactly, so it should probably be motor vehicle tax (marked computed). The match is by amount only.

issues.on_page: General: Grants and donations 11,970 (= operating grants 3,950 + Donations 8,020 on p2)
issues.issue: Donations are 67% of this line, so under the more-than-half rule it should be donations/contributions. Tying the column to the p2 lines relies on an amount match.

issues.on_page: Community development 239,792 (Economic Development Fund; the budget schedule on p7 calls it 'Economic development')
issues.issue: The Community Betterment rule names lines printed 'Community development/betterment'. Here the spending is in the Economic Development Fund and the budget schedule calls it Economic development, so economic development may fit. Same question for detail[13].
Nearly all Garbage Fund spending is this one 'Utilities' line, so it is probably the refuse collection contract rather than power or phone bills. The printed label supports the current category.
